question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

To take pains
solution:
The correct answer is **'To make efforts'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom** 'To take pains'** is **'To make efforts'.**
 
• **To take pains:** to try hard (to do something). [कठिन प्रयास करना (कुछ करना)]
 
 
• *Example: He** took (great) pains **to explain the situation to us.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *To make efforts.*
